text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a latency drift in the int8 canary this morning. p95 up ~18% for mid-length (128-256) sequences. Anyone else seeing this?
samir: yup, CI perf run flagged it: job 5962. p95 jump after merge a few hours ago.
ci-bot: [perf-alert] job=5962, diff:+18% p95, regression detected in eng-runtime/int8-path
jon: which merge? any good suspect commits?
rachel: looks correlated with PR #4127 — prefetcher heuristics + kernel selection tweak. telemetry shows KV cache hits down ~12% on the same interval.
maya: curious — why would prefetch change affect KV hits? that should be separate.
rachel: my theory: the prefetcher changed the ordering of layer loads which shifted tensor layout -> different kernel chosen -> KV layout alignment changed, causing slightly worse hit locality.
samir: repro locally: run short seqs vs mid seqs on the canary build. I get same pattern. attaching quick profile:
```
perf: timeline
- rpc_dispatch  ms  3.4 -> 3.9
- dequantize_hot  ms  1.2 -> 2.0
- kv_lookup     ms  0.8 -> 1.4
- kernel_select ms  0.1 -> 0.5
```
kv-hit-rate: 88% -> 76%
jon: interesting, dequantize_hot doubled. is that from different kernel route? maybe dequant path now runs in a fallback scalar loop.
maya: can we bisect to the exact commit in #4127? maybe the packer reordering was too aggressive.
ci-bot: bisect job scheduled (job 5970).
samir: ran a quick revert of the prefetcher reorder locally (diff below). latency goes back to baseline for mid seqs. so safe short-term revert.
```diff
- reorder_prefetch_layers(opt=true)
+ reorder_prefetch_layers(opt=false)
```
ops-bot: paused canary rollout for int8 on gcp-us-west-2 :octagon:
jon: thanks. long-term we should add a micro-instrument in kernel selector that logs chosen kernel + kv-alignment flag per request so we can correlate. small patch:
```diff
+ trace.set("kernel.choice", kernel_id)
+ trace.set("kv.align", kv_aligned)
```
rachel: already capturing kernel_id in limited traces, but not kv.align. adding that now. also pushing an eval run to check output quality on the non-reverted path (we saw tiny perplexity diff earlier).
maya: exact action list?
rachel: 1) revert reorder in canary (samir done locally) 2) add kv.align to traces (jon) 3) run batch eval for quality (rachel) 4) re-run canary with enhanced telemetry.
samir: revert PR ready, test matrix green locally, pushing now.
deploy-bot: PR #4192 merged (revert: prefetch reorder).
ci-bot: quick canary perf run post-merge: p95 back to baseline (within noise), kv-hit-rate restored to 90%
maya: nice. leaving rollout paused until we get full canary pass, but this looks promising.
jon: follow-up: we should add an automated check in CI that simulates mid-length seq distribution and validates kv-hit-rate delta < 5% on critical merges that touch prefetch/kernel selection.
rachel: agreed. I'll file a small GH issue with repro steps + telemetry snippet.
samir: tl;dr — prefetch reorder + kernel selector interaction caused dequant hotpath to take fallback path and reduced kv locality, causing p95 drift in int8 canary. revert mitigates.
maya: thanks all. next steps in issue and include suggested CI test. :thumbsup:
